clauses.title: Focus on value
clauses.text: Everything the organization does shall link, directly or indirectly, to value for the stakeholders.

clauses.title: Start where you are
clauses.text: Do not start from scratch when planning new initiatives; assess and reuse what is already available.

clauses.title: Progress iteratively with feedback
clauses.text: Organize work into smaller, manageable sections that can be executed and completed in a timely manner, with feedback informing each iteration.

clauses.title: Collaborate and promote visibility
clauses.text: Work together across boundaries to produce results that have buy-in, relevance to objectives and increased likelihood of long-term success.

clauses.title: Think and work holistically
clauses.text: No service, practice, process, department or supplier stands alone; outcomes will suffer unless the organization works on the whole.

clauses.title: Keep it simple and practical
clauses.text: If a process, service, action or metric provides no value or produces no useful outcome, eliminate it.

clauses.title: Optimize and automate
clauses.text: Resources of all types, particularly human resources, shall be used to their best effect; eliminate anything truly wasteful and use technology to achieve whatever it is capable of.
